final_message:
The bug was in `refund_invoice` in `billing/refunds.py`. It called `successful_payments(invoice["id"], ctx)`, but the function's signature is `(ctx, invoice_id)`. The arguments were swapped, so `ctx` was a string and `ctx.store` raised the `AttributeError`. I swapped them back.

I ran the full suite with your test temporarily added, and all 25 tests passed. I removed the temporary test file afterwards, so your test isn't in the suite yet. `answer.json` is written in the repo root as `{"file": "refunds.py", "function": "refund_invoice"}`.

steps.command:
cat > /tmp/t.py <<'E'
from billing import reports
def test_x(world):
    cus = world.customer()
    world.engine.subscribe(cus["id"], [(world.monthly["id"], 1)])
    [inv] = world.engine.invoices_for(cus["id"])
    world.engine.refund(inv["id"])
    assert reports.revenue_between(world.ctx, inv["paid_at"], inv["paid_at"] + 1) == {"usd": 0}
E
cp /tmp/t.py tests/test_tmp_x.py; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_tmp_x.py 2>&1 | tail -30; rm tests/test_tmp_x.py; grep -n "credit_note" -r billing | head -30

grep -rn "successful_payments" billing; sed -i 's/successful_payments(invoice\["id"\], ctx)/successful_payments(ctx, invoice["id"])/' billing/refunds.py; echo '{"file": "refunds.py", "function": "refund_invoice"}' > answer.json; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5
cp /tmp/t.py tests/test_tmp_x.py; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -15; rm tests/test_tmp_x.py; cat answer.json
